chapter.title: Refining
chapter.summary: Mined ore goes to a refinery, not a regular commodity terminal.

objectives.title: Take your first load of ore to a refinery
objectives.why: Unrefined commodities such as mined ore can't be sold at regular commodity terminals; they go to a refinery for processing. Refineries are found at major spaceports and stations.

steps.do: Choose a refinery. mobiOverlay's Refinery Finder card compares refineries and methods from live UEX data.
Fly there and land legally (request landing).
steps.where: A station or major spaceport with a refinery
steps.done_when: You're landed at the refinery's location.

steps.do: Hand your ore to the refinery for processing.
steps.done_when: The refinery has taken your ore.
